question_text: Read the beginning of a story. Write ten new sentences
stimulus: to complete the story. 1×10=10 Once the house of a rich man was infested with rats. The house became like the house of Hamelin. There were rats every where. They made hole here and there. They tore papers, clothes etc. They always made noise and the members of the house could not sleep for it. So one day the house master brought a cat to kill the rats. The cat began to kill the rats every day.....
